titles.english: Animelo Summer Live 2017 x Kemono Friends
titles.native: けものフレンズ×アニサマ2017

description:
A Kemono Friends short that served as the intro for all three days of the 2017 Animelo Summer Live -THE CARD- anisong event.

The Friends are asked by the PPP to clean up the abandoned Saitama Super Arena stage so they can use it for a concert. While the rest of the Friends take care of business, Northern White-faced Owl and Eurasian Eagle Owl discover and read from cards left behind by humans explaining event etiquette. The short features two alternate endings.

(Source: YouTube)
